author: Ministerio de las Culturas, las Artes y el Patrimonio
title: Ministerio de las Culturas, las Artes y el Patrimonio collection record for Moai pa'apa'a, Rapa Nui — 17-259

claims.value: Figura tradicionalmente femenina tallada en madera. Tiene tallados rasgos femeninos, como la vulva, aunque también tiene barba en el mentón.

captures.note: Official fiche and photograph preserved; image reuse rights not cleared.

notes.text: The official search result for accession 17-259 linked to DOI 02SDC-17-259 and SURDOC registration 17-259. The title is the generic Escultura. The official photograph was compared with the IndiGen gallery image; distinctive face, eyes, head and beard match. The record describes the figure as traditionally female and notes a beard; that wording is retained. No image is published because no item-specific reuse permission was established.
